function rhythmGame(g, o) {
  return new Promise(res => {
    const el = document.createElement('div'); el.id = 'rhythm';
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="meter"><span></span><div class="bar"><i></i></div></div><div class="lanes"><div class="lane"><b>A</b></div><div class="lane"><b>S</b></div><div class="lane"><b>D</b></div><div class="hitline"></div></div>';
    document.body.appendChild(el);
    el.querySelector('.meter span').textContent = tr(o.label);
    const lanes = [...el.querySelectorAll('.lane')], bar = el.querySelector('.bar i');
    if (IS_TOUCH) lanes.forEach(l => { l.querySelector('b').textContent = ''; });
    let calm = o.start ?? 25, t = 0, next = 0.8, notes = [], paused = false, done = false, evI = 0, step = 0;
    const TRAVEL = 1.8, HIT = 0.86, goal = o.goal ?? 100, pat = [0, 1, 2, 1, 0, 2, 1, 2];
    const chords = [[0, 3, 7], [2, 5, 9], [-2, 3, 7], [0, 5, 10]];
    const press = l => {
      if (paused || done) return; lanes[l].classList.add('hit'); setTimeout(() => lanes[l].classList.remove('hit'), 110);
      let best = null, bd = 1; for (const n of notes) { if (n.lane !== l || n.hit || n.missed) continue; const d = Math.abs((t - n.t) / TRAVEL - HIT); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = n; } }
      if (best && bd < 0.12) { best.hit = true; best.el.remove(); calm = Math.min(goal, calm + 5); if (g.audio.ctx && !g.audio.muted) g.audio.pluck(293.66 * Math.pow(2, best.semi / 12), g.audio.ctx.currentTime, 0.4, g.audio.master); }
      else calm = Math.max(0, calm - 1);
    };
    const keyMap = { KeyA: 0, ArrowLeft: 0, KeyJ: 0, Digit1: 0, KeyS: 1, ArrowDown: 1, KeyK: 1, Digit2: 1, KeyD: 2, ArrowRight: 2, KeyL: 2, Digit3: 2 };
    const onKey = e => { if (e.repeat) return; const l = keyMap[e.code]; if (l != null) { e.preventDefault(); press(l); } };
    addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    lanes.forEach((ln, i) => ln.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { e.preventDefault(); press(i); }));
    const tok = g.tok;
    g.every(dt => {
      if (done) return false;
      if (tok !== g.tok) { done = true; removeEventListener('keydown', onKey); el.remove(); return false; }
      bar.style.width = (calm / goal * 100) + '%';
      el.style.visibility = paused ? 'hidden' : 'visible';
      if (paused) return;
      t += dt;
      if (t >= next) {
        step++; let lane = pat[step % 8]; if (Math.random() < 0.25) lane = (lane + 1) % 3;
        const semi = chords[Math.floor(step / 8) % 4][lane] + (Math.random() < 0.2 ? 12 : 0);
        const d = document.createElement('div'); d.className = 'note'; lanes[lane].appendChild(d);
        notes.push({ lane, t, el: d, semi }); next = t + (o.gap ?? 0.6) * (Math.random() < 0.2 ? 0.5 : 1);
      }
      const h = lanes[0].clientHeight;
      for (const n of notes) {
        if (n.hit) continue; const y = (t - n.t) / TRAVEL; n.el.style.top = (y * h - 17) + 'px';
        if (!n.missed && y > HIT + 0.13) { n.missed = true; n.el.classList.add('miss'); calm = Math.max(0, calm - 4); }
        if (y > 1.1) { n.el.remove(); n.hit = true; }
      }
      notes = notes.filter(n => !n.hit);
      const evs = o.events || [];
      if (evI < evs.length && calm >= evs[evI].at) { paused = true; const ev = evs[evI++]; notes.forEach(n => n.el.remove()); notes = []; Promise.resolve(ev.fn()).then(() => { paused = false; next = t + 0.9; }); }
      else if (calm >= goal && evI >= evs.length) { done = true; removeEventListener('keydown', onKey); el.remove(); res(); }
    });
    g._rhythm = { hitAll: () => { calm = goal; } };
    /* graphics-lifecycle:start */
    g.onChapterCleanup?.(() => { done = true; removeEventListener('keydown', onKey); el.remove(); });
    /* graphics-lifecycle:end */
  });
}
